2. Mr. V. D. Sapkal, Sr. Counsel a/w Ms. S. P. Patil, i/b Mr. S. R. Sapkal, learned Counsel for the petitioner who was also a stake holder to the compensation had objection as regards to partial compromise that took place before the authority.
He would submit that any compromise must be a full and final settlement and must be executed before the Civil Court.

Mr. Sapkal, learned Senior Counsel submits that during pendency of this petition, the compromise between all the parties to the litigation and all the stake holders in the subject 21-wp-12552-2024 matter/compensation has taken place in Special Civil Suit No.333 of 2014 pending in the Court of learned Civil Judge Senior Division, Aurangabad.
